name: Inia Shestina
original_name: イーニァ・シェスチナ
source:
A Surface Pilot in the Idol Test Unit. She and her co-pilot Cryska are known and feared as the Scarlet Twins. Her innocent demeanor and young appearance belie her shocking aptitude as a pilot. She looks up to Cryska like an older sister, and is terribly afraid of being separated from her. Many of the things she says are mysterious, and for some reason, she takes a special interest in Yuuya.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
